In Andersonville / Uptown

A quiet room on Clark Street

Revive Massage Therapy & Spa sits at 4860 N. Clark St in Andersonville/Uptown — a neighbourhood stop for massage therapy and advanced skin care, open seven days a week.

Rated 4.8 out of 5 from 209 Google reviews (via the healthhives.com clinic page), the spa is built around unhurried appointments: time to talk through your skin or tension first, then treat it properly.

How a visit works

  1. 1.

  3. 3.

Questions

Before you book

Where is Revive located?

4860 N. Clark St, Chicago, IL 60640, in Andersonville/Uptown.

What are the opening hours?

Mon–Sun 10:00am–6:00pm, with Wed & Thu open until 8:00pm.

What is the Executive Package?

A same-day pairing: a 60-minute Revive Signature Massage plus a SkinMedica DiamondGlow Facial, priced at $295.

Is the fall promotion still running?

The published offer, Fall Into Your Glow, runs October 1–31: a free HA5 Foaming Cleanser ($48 value) with any DiamondGlow Facial + Dermaplaning.

How do I book?

Use the form below — it opens your own email app addressed to info@revivemassagechicago.com. Or call 773.675.1918.

Do you offer laser and advanced facials?

Yes — the MedSpa menu includes MOXI + BBL, CoolPeel laser resurfacing, microneedling, laser hair reduction, PDRN + stem-cell facials, and DiamondGlow. Ask about any of them in the booking form.
